stories.headline: William Orbit: Madonna and Blur producer dies aged 69 - BBC
stories.summary: The British producer helped to reinvigorate Madonna's career and also worked with All Saints and U2.
stories.why: Orbit shaped the sound of the '90s you grew up with—Madonna's 'Ray of Light,' the Britpop explosion—and his death marks the end of a production era when one person could authentically bridge pop and alternative music.

stories.headline: 'Descendants' Universe Expands With New Film About Kids Of Sidekicks - Deadline
stories.summary: 'HIdden Heroes: A Descendants Story' will follow the offspring of Disney sidekicks from 'Aladdin,' 'The Emperor's New Groove' and more
stories.why: This signals Disney is mining nostalgia IP for content that speaks to millennial dads now introducing their kids to what they watched, while quietly acknowledging the sidekick characters were often more interesting than the leads.

stories.headline: Horniness is having a moment. A new romcom is seizing it. - CNN
stories.summary: A new movie starring Callum Turner and Monica Barbaro bets audiences want to see salacious scenes. After “Heated Rivalry” and other hits this year, it’s a safe bet.
stories.why: After a decade of streaming-era restraint, studios are betting that men in this age group (who grew up on actual R-rated comedies) are hungry for unapologetic sexuality onscreen again—this is a cultural permission slip being tested.

stories.headline: The new movie about Anthony Bourdain is none of the things you fear it could be - npr.org
stories.summary: The internationally known chef, writer, and television star died in 2018. Tony, starring Dominic Sessa, tells just a splinter of Bourdain's life — the mid-1970s summer when he was 19.
stories.why: The film avoids hagiography or tragedy-porn by focusing on Bourdain's pre-fame moment of potential, which matters because it reframes how your generation discusses him beyond the headlines—as a flawed human becoming, not a myth defined by his ending.

stories.headline: Toni Braxton Resolves 6-Figure Tax Debt Years After Bankruptcy - TMZ
stories.summary: Toni Braxton says she dropped some serious dough to settle a debt with the IRS … over a decade after she finalized her second bankruptcy.
stories.why: Braxton's financial recovery after bankruptcy signals that even major '90s icons faced real consequences and had to rebuild, making her story more relatable than the typical celebrity comeback narrative.

stories.headline: Lionel Richie, Earth, Wind & Fire concert at San Francisco's Chase Center postponed last-minute due to medical emergency - ABC7 Bay Area
stories.summary: The Chase Center and Earth, Wind & Fire issued statements at 7:20 p.m. for the 7:30 p.m. show, forcing thousands of fans inside the arena and waiting in lines outside to exit the building.
stories.why: A last-minute medical emergency canceling a legacy R&B/soul show is a stark reminder of mortality for the artists who soundtracked your formative years—these touring opportunities won't always be there.

stories.headline: 'Alley Cats' Review: Ricky Gervais Netflix Comedy Is Bittersweet - Variety
stories.summary: With the animated Netflix comedy 'Alley Cats', Ricky Gervais strikes a surprisingly bittersweet tone.
stories.why: Gervais pivoting to animated bittersweet comedy (not just shock-value standup) suggests aging comedians are finding new ways to do character-driven work that resonates differently than their peak provocateur years.
